Title: Senior Incident Manager
Description:
Crusoe is on a mission
*to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*
. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.
  
  
We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.
  
  
We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.
  
  
If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.
  
  
**About This Role:**
As a Senior Incident Manager at Crusoe, you'll lead the response when things go wrong, coordinating the right people across teams, driving urgency, and keeping everyone focused until customer-impacting issues are resolved. You'll own communication throughout that process, including internal updates that keep responders coordinated and leadership informed, and status page decisions that keep customers informed. Once an incident is resolved, you'll drive the post-incident review process, ensuring postmortems are written and debriefs are held on time, then translate those findings into a clear, customer-facing root cause analysis (RCA) that builds lasting trust with enterprise customers and executives. You'll also maintain the incident metrics and reporting that show how we're performing, and ensure preventative actions coming out of incidents are properly documented and tracked.
  
  
In this full-time position, you'll have the opportunity to shape and enhance our incident management processes as the team and company scale, improving how we detect, respond to, and learn from incidents. The ideal candidate combines strong incident coordination fundamentals with real experience writing customer-facing root cause analysis to enterprise customers, plus the analytical rigor to track and report on incident data, and basic technical fluency to engage credibly with infrastructure teams, without needing to be the one troubleshooting.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Working On:**

* Incident Response Leadership: Lead end-to-end management of high-visibility technical incidents and enterprise customer escalations, ensuring rapid restoration of services and effective communication throughout the lifecycle.
* Incident Coordination: Coordinate the response effort across teams during an incident — you won't be troubleshooting the technical issue yourself, but you'll work closely with responders to determine which teams are needed and ensure everyone stays focused in the right direction.
* Strategic Collaboration: Act as a critical bridge between Customer Success and internal engineering/product teams, translating frontline feedback into actionable incident response steps.
* Customer Communication & Judgment: Own status page communications — determining the right level of detail and the best way to frame updates so customers get clear, useful information. This requires more judgment at a startup, where communication practices are still being defined, versus larger, more established companies.
* RCA Ownership: Own end-to-end production of customer-facing root cause analyses — translating incident data into clear, structured writing for enterprise customers and executives.
* Corrective Action Documentation: Ensure proper documentation of internal corrective actions coming out of incidents, driving improvements to the reliability of our products and platform.
* Incident Metrics & Reporting: Maintain and report on core incident metrics (response time, resolution time, time to RCA delivery), ensuring incident data is accurate and complete.
* Knowledge Empowerment: Develop and deliver training materials, internal documentation, and knowledge base articles for teammates and customers.
* Process Innovation: Design and implement incident response strategies and self-serve support processes to scale the function as the team grows.
* On-Call Participation: Participate in on-call rotation, 10am–10pm coverage, 5 days per week, providing a reliable safety net for critical service interruptions.

**What You’ll Bring to the Team:**

* Background on an enterprise customer support team, or direct experience working with enterprise customers
* Strong written communication — able to turn technical, ambiguous incident detail into clear, structured narratives for a non-technical audience
* Understands the nuances of what can and cannot be communicated to customers, including what needs to be documented in writing
* Strong judgment on communication level — knowing what to filter out when reporting bad news, since each incident case is different
* Sound judgment on transparency — knowing when to stay high-level vs. go into detail
* Logical, structured thinker with a solid grounding in incident management process and best practices
* Comfortable working with data to track and report on trends, not just handling incidents in the moment
* Working familiarity with Linux, virtualization, and Kubernetes — comfortable enough to engage credibly with infrastructure and technical responders during an incident, without needing to be the one troubleshooting

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience working with customers in a startup environment, with an understanding of the complexities that come with it
* Background in cloud infrastructure or AI-focused environments
* Understanding of Virtualization and orchestration/scheduling technologies (Slurm or Kubernetes)
* Hands-on experience with Linux, virtualization, or Kubernetes
* Understanding of the TCP/IP stack
* Understanding of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices

**What Makes This Role Compelling:**

* Builder mentality welcome: the opportunity to create and refine incident management processes, leave a lasting imprint on the function, and grow alongside the team as it scales
* Real scaling story: the team has grown from 2 people covering 24x7 to a team of 5, with continued growth ahead — a chance to help scale the function without sacrificing quality
* Exposure to cutting-edge AI infrastructure across the full stack: compute, networking (SDN), storage (VAST), Kubernetes, and Slurm

Title: Incident Response Manager
Description:
Overview:

**Our Culture and Impact**

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

The Incident Response Manager is a cross-functional position responsible for managing and coordinating the response to customer-facing incidents for both Cvent Event Cloud and Hospitality Cloud. This role reports directly to the Senior Director of Retention & Incident Command and serves as the project manager and primary liaison between Client Services, Technology, Engineering, Legal, Sales Management, Information Security, Finance and Operations departments, as needed when incidents occur. They validate impact data, drive clear, accurate communication to customers, and strategize with other teams on appropriate resolution. They attend retrospectives and track financial impact related to incidents to identify operational improvements that help prevent future incidents and strengthen internal processes.

In This Role, You Will::

* Own the customer facing communication workstream for incidents including, but not limited to communication templates, cadence, approvals, audience targeting, and delivery across appropriate channels, etc.
* Develop, document, and continually improve incident response processes for customer-facing issues, ensuring alignment with company policies and industry best practices.
* Lead cross-functional incident response projects, orchestrating efforts between the necessary teams and ensuring effective and efficient handling and collaboration.
* Act as the bridge between technical, legal, and business teams to drive fast and appropriate resolutions, minimize impact, and safeguard customer trust.
* Work with necessary internal parties on root cause analyses, corrective actions, and preventative measures following incidents.
* Communicate incident status, impact, and action plans effectively to internal stakeholders and customer contacts as appropriate.
* Serve as the main point of contact during high-priority or critical customer-facing incidents, ensuring leadership is kept informed.
* Track, analyze, and report on incident trends, financial impact, and the frequency and volume of customer escalations, contributing insights to reduce recurring issues and improve customer experiences.
* Organize and develop incident simulation exercises and updated trainings to enhance readiness across the Sales and Client Services teams.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for all incidents, aligning with compliance and legal guidelines.
* Update existing executive escalation guidelines with clear processes and work with teams to facilitate as needed; direct customer-facing involvement will be rare.
* Continuously identify areas of improvement with Cvent internal processes and special projects, including but not limited to, Fraud Risk Management.

Here's What You Need::

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 3-4 years of account management, client services, incident response, crisis management, project management, or similar disciplines, preferably within the event, hotel, or travel industries.
* Must display exceptional written and verbal communication skills, as you may be interacting with C-level executives (both internally and externally).
* Comfortable learning, using and discussing very granular elements of Cvent technology and integrations.
* Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues for non-technical audiences and manage multiple priorities under pressure.
* Experience with process improvement, project leadership, program management, and/or technical troubleshooting preferred.
* Articulate, organized, detail-oriented, and possess the ability to multi-task in a dynamic, extremely fast-paced and ever-changing, entrepreneurial environment.

* Comfortable operating with ambiguity and adapting processes rapidly.

Title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization
Description:
**Job Description**

  

**Vacancy Status:** This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

**AI Disclosure:** As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.

  

**The Team & Opportunity**
--------------------------

  

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

  

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

  

The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on technology leader with a track record of operating and modernizing complex enterprise data environments. They can lead multidisciplinary teams across data engineering, business analysis, data quality, and governance; align business and technology stakeholders around a clear modernization roadmap; and deliver large-scale migration while protecting the reliability of existing services. They understand how to build trusted, well-governed data foundations that enable enterprise-wide analytics and AI adoption.

  

**The Role**
------------

As the Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization, you will lead the team responsible for the day-to-day health and continued operation of the existing enterprise data warehouse, as well as its modernization and migration to a cloud-based environment. You will set direction, establish delivery and operational priorities, and ensure the platform evolves to meet the needs of GM Canada and the wider enterprise.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team comprising three Data Engineering, Cloud Migration & Platforms Engineers; one Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration; one Data Validation & Data Quality Analyst, Enterprise Data; and one Data Governance Analyst. You will bring these capabilities together into a coordinated operating model that delivers reliable services, high-quality and well-governed data, and a successful migration. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating priorities for the enterprise data environment, balancing current service needs with modernization and migration objectives.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team across data engineering, business analysis, data validation and quality, and data governance; clarify accountability, establish expectations, and support professional growth.
* Maintain the reliability, availability, performance, security, and supportability of the existing enterprise data warehouse and its critical data pipelines.
* Lead the planning and execution of the enterprise data warehouse migration to a cloud-based environment, including scope, sequencing, dependencies, risks, resourcing, milestones, and business readiness.
* Direct modernization of data architecture, platforms, pipelines, processes, and controls to improve scalability, automation, resilience, maintainability, and cost effectiveness.
* Establish a practical transition strategy that protects business continuity, manages legacy and cloud coexistence, and ensures migrated workloads and data meet agreed operational and business requirements.
* Ensure migration outcomes are validated through appropriate testing, reconciliation, data-quality controls, business acceptance, and production-readiness reviews.
* Set expectations for engineering standards and practices, including architecture, automation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, testing, observability, incident response, and documentation.
* Establish and oversee data-quality practices that monitor completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and schema conformance across source, pipeline, and warehouse data.
* Lead data governance practices that support clear ownership, stewardship, definitions, metadata, lineage, access controls, classification, retention, and responsible use of enterprise data.
* Build trusted relationships with business leaders, GM Canada stakeholders, enterprise data consumers, technology partners, security and risk teams, and global platform organizations.
* Translate business priorities into a sequenced and measurable data roadmap, ensuring stakeholder needs and downstream impacts are represented in decisions.
* Oversee requirements management, backlog priorities, sprint and release planning, delivery tracking, risk and issue management, and cross-team dependencies.
* Establish clear measures of success for platform health, service reliability, migration progress, data quality, governance, delivery outcomes, and customer or business impact.
* Ensure operational procedures, support models, escalation paths, service expectations, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place for both legacy and cloud environments.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and data-informed decision-making across the team.
* Guide the development of secure, trusted, discoverable, and well-documented data foundations that can support analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise-wide AI adoption.
Communicate progress, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders and delivery partners.  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant progressive experience leading enterprise data, data engineering, data platforms, technology modernization, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering complex, enterprise-scale data or technology initiatives.
* Experience operating and modernizing enterprise data warehouses and production data platforms, preferably including Oracle-based environments.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale data platform or warehouse migrations, from assessment and planning through implementation, validation, and operational transition.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, data integration, ETL/ELT, cloud data platforms, data quality, and enterprise data operations.
* Experience establishing governance, security, privacy, quality, reliability, and operational practices for business-critical data environments.
* Ability to set strategic direction while maintaining sufficient technical depth to evaluate architecture, delivery approaches, risks, and trade-offs.
* Strong business and financial judgment, with the ability to prioritize work and resources against enterprise outcomes and operational needs.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills, including the ability to align senior business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong change leadership skills and the ability to guide teams and stakeholders through complex modernization while sustaining current operations.
* Experience with Agile or iterative delivery models, portfolio or roadmap planning, and management of complex cross-functional dependencies.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and risk-management capabilities.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience leading an on-premises Oracle data warehouse migration to Azure, Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, BigQuery, Synapse, or equivalent enterprise data and lakehouse technologies.
* Familiarity with cloud platform engineering, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data pipeline automation, and cloud operations.
* Experience establishing data observability, automated data-quality controls, reconciliation practices, and operational scorecards.
* Experience leading data governance and stewardship programs, including cataloging, lineage, classification, data ownership, and access management.
* Experience modernizing data platforms and operating models to support advanced analytics, machine learning, or enterprise AI use cases.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed, regulated, or security-sensitive enterprise environment.
Familiarity with enterprise tools and practices for Agile delivery, service management, documentation, and operational monitoring.

Title: Director of IT Service Management
Description:
**Job Description**
**A Day in the Life:**
The Director of IT Service Management leads the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Hertz’s global IT service management practices. This role turns technology and business priorities into reliable, measurable service operations, supporting a consistent experience for employees and business partners across the company.
  
  
Working with Technology and business leaders, the Director oversees key service management processes and the systems that support them, including ServiceNow. The role partners closely with infrastructure, end-user services, application, cybersecurity, and operations teams to improve service quality, system stability, resiliency, and compliance. * Set expectations for vendors and service providers supporting ITSM processes; monitor service levels, delivery, governance, and cost-effectiveness.

* Identify relevant technology and industry developments, including ITIL 4, ServiceNow, and DevOps practices, and assess their value to Hertz.
* Communicate service performance, risks, priorities, and improvement plans clearly to executives, business partners, employees, and vendors.
* Build effective working relationships across Technology and the business to coordinate service ownership and resolve operational issues.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* ITIL 4 certification preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
* 10+ years of progressive IT experience in infrastructure, end-user services, service management, or technology operations.
* Significant people leadership experience, including leading teams and developing talent; experience managing service operations in a large, distributed enterprise preferred.
* Experience in leading or improving enterprise IT service management practices, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management (CMDB).
* Hands-on familiarity with ITSM platforms and workflows; ServiceNow experience strongly preferred.
* Experience managing service providers or managed service providers, including performance against service levels and contractual commitments.
* Knowledge of technology operations and service delivery in a complex, multi-location environment.
* Ability to use operational data and service metrics to set priorities, improve performance, and communicate results.
* Strong communication, presentation, documentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and develop teams, manage competing priorities, and lead complex improvement initiatives.
* Strong customer focus, sound judgment, and adaptability in a dynamic environment.
* Courageous leadership and accountability.

Title: Cybersecurity Operations Manager
Description:
**Description**
Are you a cybersecurity leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys solving complex security challenges? Join us as a
**Manager, Cybersecurity Operations**
and lead security operations, incident response, and continuous improvement initiatives that help protect our business and Team Members every day.
  
  
**Position:**
Cybersecurity Operations Manager
  
  
**Job Overview**
This role provides operational leadership across cybersecurity monitoring, incident triage, investigation coordination, vulnerability management, remediation tracking, vendor coordination, security reporting, and operational follow-up. The role manages cybersecurity analysts, supports team coverage and cross-training, and works with IT teams, vendors, and external partners to resolve security issues and drive remediation actions.
  
  
The role is also accountable for ensuring incidents are investigated, documented, contained, remediated, and followed through to closure, while maintaining ownership of the incident response plan, escalation paths, operational playbooks, and regular incident response tabletop exercises.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Lead day-to-day cybersecurity operations, including security monitoring, incident triage, investigation coordination, vulnerability management, remediation tracking, and operational follow-up.
* Act as the primary internal operational contact for managed security service providers and security vendors, including escalation review, service quality, reporting, and improvement follow-up.
* Manage, coach, and develop cybersecurity analysts, including work prioritization, performance management, career development, and quality of delivery.
* Build appropriate team coverage, cross-training, and documentation to reduce dependency on individual team members.
* Ensure security incidents are appropriately investigated, documented, contained, remediated, and followed through to closure.
* Own and maintain the incident response plan, escalation paths, operational playbooks, and regular incident response tabletop exercises.
* Make day-to-day operational decisions within established security processes and escalate material risks, exceptions, vendor concerns, or issues requiring leadership direction.
* Prioritize operational activities, remediation efforts, and team capacity based on risk, business impact, service requirements, and available resources.
* Drive continuous improvement of incident response processes, operational procedures, monitoring practices, and security controls.
* Support cybersecurity initiatives where operational input, testing, implementation support, or transition into ongoing support is required.
* Provide security input into relevant technology and operational changes, and support other areas of IT and the business based on operational demand.
* Work with IT teams, vendors, and external partners to resolve security issues, drive remediation actions, and clarify ownership and timelines.
* Use operational metrics and trends to identify improvement opportunities and report on security performance.
* Support security assurance, audit, compliance, and third-party security assessment activities as needed.

**Health And Safety**

* Promotes and endorses Safety Vision “Safety is our way of life”.
* Observes and support Longo’s Safe Work guidelines and other safe work practices.
* Role models the importance of health and safety by always working safely, and calls out and addressed and safety issues.
* Recognizes risks which may pose a danger to Team Members and customers and resolves such issues (where possible) or modifies work, mitigating the risk to Team Member/customer until resolution can be sourced and implemented (i.e. Longo’s Call Center Harassment/Violence Reference Guide)
* Ensures all pre-use checks (where applicable) are conducted and all equipment is maintained to provide for safe operation by Team Members.
* Ensures that TMs are trained to safely carry out their work in the department, and ensures that all work is safely carried out by Team Members.

**Key Area Of Responsibility**

* Partner with IT, Infrastructure, Application Support, Service Desk, vendors, and external partners to address cybersecurity issues and remediation activities.
* Provide security input into technology changes and operational initiatives.
* Support audit, compliance, security assurance, and third-party security assessment activities.
* Escalate material risks, operational issues, exceptions, vendor concerns, or decisions requiring leadership direction, and act as a point of escalation for urgent cybersecurity issues outside regular business hours when required.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong operational leadership, with the ability to prioritize effectively, make sound decisions, and maintain accountability across the team.
* Comfortable working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, unexpected issues, and competing deadlines.
* Calm, structured, and solution-focused during incidents, escalations, and high-pressure situations.
* Able to take ownership, make practical recommendations, and drive issues through to resolution.
* Effective at coaching team members while maintaining high standards for quality, documentation, and follow-through.
* Able to operate effectively with incomplete information or unclear ownership, using sound judgement and escalating when leadership direction is required.
* Able to communicate security risks, operational priorities, progress, and decisions clearly to technical teams, vendors, and leadership.

**Required**
**Knowledge, Skills & Credentials:**

* 6 to 8 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, IT infrastructure, or a related technical field.
* 1 to 3 years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing cybersecurity analysts, technical teams, or security workstreams.
* Experience with security monitoring, incident triage, incident response, vulnerability management, or security operations.
* Experience overseeing or working within an MSSP-supported security operations model, including alert escalation, incident coordination, and service performance management.
* Experience working with managed security service providers, security vendors, or external security partners.
* Familiarity with enterprise security technologies across endpoint security, identity and access management, network segmentation, vulnerability management, email security, network security, cloud security, or security service management.
* Working knowledge of security frameworks or compliance requirements such as PCI-DSS, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, or similar.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, reporting, and documentation skills.
* Experience maintaining or supporting incident response plans, escalation procedures, playbooks, and tabletop exercises.

**Preferred / Asset**

* Experience supporting third-party security assessments, vendor security reviews, or remediation tracking.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, control validation, or remediation activities.
* Experience developing operational metrics, dashboards, KPIs, KRIs, or management reporting.
* Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Security+, GCIH, GCIA, or equivalent.
* ITIL, PMP, Scrum, or formal project management experience.

**Working Conditions**

* Full-time, permanent role.
* Fast-paced operational environment with shifting priorities, unexpected issues, and competing deadlines.
* Role may require participation in incident response, escalations, vendor coordination, and time-sensitive remediation activities.
* Requires regular communication with technical teams, vendors, external partners, and leadership.
* Requires availability to participate in an on-call or escalation rotation and act as a point of escalation for urgent cybersecurity issues outside regular business hours when required.

Title: Network Systems Manager
Description:
The Network Systems Manager oversees the daily operational engineering, maintenance, management, and continuous optimization of the enterprise network infrastructure supporting the Air Force National Capital Region (AFNCR). This role ensures maximum network uptime, robust cybersecurity enforcement, and seamless mission-critical data transport across both unclassified (NIPR) and classified (SIPR/JWICS) secure enclaves
  
  
The Manager provides senior-level technical direction and leadership to a team of engineers and technicians, ensuring full alignment with Department of Defense (DoD) regulations and program objectives.
  
  
Since 1976, SMS has specialized in modernizing legacy IT and sustaining complex enterprise environments for federal agencies. With the goal of building long-term partnerships with our customers, we invest in our employees by providing the training, tools, and support they need to keep critical missions operational, improve performance, and reduce risk. SMS is headquartered in McLean, Virginia, with offices and on-site operations at customer locations throughout the United States. For additional information on SMS, visit www.sms.com.
  
  
Submit your resume today!
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Infrastructure Management: Oversee the configuration, deployment, optimization, and lifecycle management of core data center and enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure, including Cisco Nexus and Catalyst switches, routers, F5 Load Balancers, and Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
* Operational Leadership: Manage a specialized team of network engineers and operations center specialists; coordinate shift logs, escalate tickets, and lead complex troubleshooting across physical, virtual, and transport layers.
* Security & Compliance: Enforce physical and logical cybersecurity measures in strict adherence to DoD regulations. Ensure network baselines maintain STIG compliance, support Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) remediation, and provide technical artifacts for RMF accreditation.
* Access Control & Crypto: Manage enterprise network systems utilizing Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco Catalyst Center for automated access control, device profiling, and policy enforcement. Support TACLANE/HAIPE encryptors (e.g., KG-175D) to secure sensitive data-in-transit.
* Performance Monitoring: Utilize telemetry and network monitoring tools (such as Cacti or other SNMP-based software) to closely track system capacity, application availability, and overall environmental health
* Documentation & Governance: Develop, enforce, and audit detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), network topology maps, rack layouts, and precise asset tracking databases
* Stakeholder Liaison: Serve as a primary technical contact for government stakeholders, Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs), and prime program leadership regarding network upgrades and configuration modifications.

**Required Qualifications**

* CCNA required, CCNP preferred
* Active DoD Secret security clearance
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field (Equivalent professional experience may be substituted on a 2-for-1 basis)
* Experience: Minimum of 8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering, network operations, or infrastructure support, with at least 2–3 years in a team lead, supervisory, or management capacity within a secure federal defense or intelligence environment.
* Network Access Control: Experience designing, implementing, operating, and maintaining IEEE 802.1X authentication and network access control solutions using Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), including integration with wired network infrastructure, identity sources, endpoint profiling, policy administration, and troubleshooting authentication and authorization issues.
* Application Delivery and Access Management: Experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting F5 BIG-IP Load Balancers, including Local Traffic Manager (LTM) and Access Policy Manager (APM) modules. Experience should include virtual servers, pools, health monitors, traffic policies, SSL/TLS configuration, high availability, and access-policy configuration.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Demonstrate experience managing automated network configuration workflows and software-defined network spaces.
* Familiarity with deploying multicast-based platforms (such as IPTV architectures) across enterprise local area networks.
* Exceptional communication skills, with a proven track record of managing interdisciplinary cleared teams and translating complex technical details into executive-level briefs.

**Salary Range - $130,000 - $175,000**

Title: Director of IT Service Management
Description:
LightEdge Solutions is developing the IT solutions that will propel businesses forward over the next 10 years. Using a combination of shared and private/dedicated platforms, LightEdge has been successful in offering businesses alternatives that streamline operations, improve reliability and reduce costs.
  
  
If you are passionate about creating real solutions that help businesses with cutting-edge technology, want to be challenged to think out of the box and be in a position where you can impact change on a daily basis, then LightEdge can offer you a dynamic corporate environment built on teamwork and personal responsibility.
  
  
The Director of IT Service Management reports to the Chief Operating Officer and leads Lightedge’s ITSM governance and improvement. The Director directly leads the Change Management function; oversees the CMDB project through completion and transition to operational ownership; sponsors Problem Management by setting best practices, sharing themes and hotspots, and driving action items to closure; and ensures Incident Management processes and tooling are optimized for effective response, communication, and operational visibility. The role sets priorities, aligns cross-functional stakeholders, and measures outcomes across these areas.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Change Management leadership**

* Lead the Change Management function across participating Lightedge teams and own its process, standards, governance, decision rights, and improvement roadmap.
* Set expectations for change types, risk and impact assessment, approvals, scheduling, conflict management, emergency changes, and post-implementation reviews.
* Lead Change Advisory Board (CAB) governance; ensure decisions, risks, conflicts, and follow-up actions have clear owners and are recorded.
* Ensure change records capture implementation, validation, backout, communication, ownership, and relevant links to services, configuration items, incidents, and problems.
* Review change outcomes and trends, including successful, failed, backed-out, emergency, and unauthorized changes; coordinate corrective improvements with responsible teams.
* Partner with ServiceNow administration and development teams to prioritize enhancements that strengthen change controls and make the process easier to use.

**CMDB project oversight**

* Oversee the CMDB project through agreed completion criteria and transition to ongoing operational ownership.
* Monitor project scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, resource needs, vendor deliverables, and acceptance criteria; raise material issues for timely resolution.
* Ensure the project establishes clear configuration item (CI) standards, data ownership, relationships, lifecycle states, quality expectations, and reconciliation practices.
* Coordinate with service, platform, product, licensing, procurement, architecture, and IT teams to improve the accuracy and usefulness of configuration records.
* Confirm discovery, automation, service mapping, and integrations are addressed where they support the approved project outcomes.
* Plan knowledge transfer, documentation, support ownership, and ongoing governance so teams can sustain the project results after completion.

**Problem Management sponsorship**

* Sponsor the Problem Management function and establish practical governance, roles, review cadence, and root-cause and corrective-action practices.
* Review recurring and high-impact issues, incident and problem themes, operational hotspots, risks, and overdue actions with accountable service and technical owners.
* Ensure problem records document known errors, workarounds, contributing factors, root-cause findings, and corrective or preventive actions.
* Track identified actions to completion, verify whether actions reduced recurrence or customer impact, and escalate unresolved risks or ownership gaps.
* Share relevant themes, hotspots, progress, and systemic improvement needs with operational leaders and stakeholders.

**Incident Management process and tooling optimization**

* Ensure Incident and Major Incident processes and ServiceNow tooling support timely restoration, clear ownership, appropriate escalation, and reliable stakeholder communications.
* Review and optimize severity criteria, workflows, response roles, major incident declaration and closure, record quality, and post-incident review practices with incident leaders and operational teams.
* Use incident trends, customer impact, feedback, and process data to identify tooling gaps, recurring friction, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with ServiceNow administrators, developers, SRE, Support, Monitoring, and service teams to prioritize and implement process, workflow, reporting, and automation improvements.

**ITSM governance, reporting, and continual improvement**

* Set clear ownership, handoffs, escalation paths, minimum records, and controls for the processes within the role’s scope.
* Consult Operations, service owners, technical leaders, Compliance, Product, Architecture, and other affected stakeholders before material process changes.
* Build understanding and adoption through practical communications, training, office hours, accessible documentation, and feedback loops.
* Establish meaningful baselines and measures for change, CMDB project delivery, problem action effectiveness, and incident process and tooling health; report progress and risks to leadership.
* Support audit readiness by maintaining process evidence, control descriptions, records, and training materials, and by coordinating responses to findings.
* Coordinate with owners of related practices such as Knowledge, Service Catalog, Event, Availability, and Service Level Management to maintain appropriate process and tool alignment.

**Guiding Principles**

* Prioritize actions that reduce customer impact, restore service safely, and support clear communications.
* Make process, record, decision, and corrective-action ownership explicit.
* Design processes with the teams that use them and apply controls proportionate to risk and urgency.
* Use trustworthy data and measured outcomes to improve service reliability, adoption, and operational efficiency.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Typically 10+ years of experience in IT Service Management, IT Operations, or a related field, including leadership of cross-functional process improvement.
* Demonstrated experience leading Change Management governance and improving Incident and Problem Management practices.
* Experience overseeing a ServiceNow CMDB or related platform project, including governance, data quality, stakeholder alignment, delivery risks, and operational transition.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL practices; ITIL 4 Foundation or higher preferred.
* Experience with ServiceNow process capabilities and CMDB governance. Familiarity with ITAM, ITOM, CSM, SOW, PPM, Telco Order Management, and Discovery is beneficial.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives and third-party professional services, including scope, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and risks.
* Ability to facilitate governance forums, resolve process disagreements, and build commitment across teams with different operational needs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate process requirements, themes, risks, and outcomes to executives and technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills; experience developing process documentation, training, dashboards, and operational reports.
* Experience supporting audits, compliance controls, or operational risk management.
* ServiceNow certifications such as Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), or relevant equivalent are beneficial.

**Measures of Success**
Performance in this role may be assessed through measures such as:
  
  

* Change process adoption, record quality, completion of required reviews, visibility of risk, and change outcome trends.
* Delivery of CMDB project milestones and acceptance criteria, CMDB data quality and ownership, and successful transition to ongoing operational support.
* Visibility and timely closure of Problem Management actions, verified effectiveness of corrective actions, and progress on recurring themes and hotspots.
* Demonstrated improvements in Incident Management workflows, tooling, record quality, reporting, escalation, and stakeholder communications.
* Stakeholder understanding and adoption of the processes within the role’s scope.
* Audit readiness, timely resolution of process findings, and measurable improvements in service reliability, operational efficiency, and customer impact.

We seek a visionary and technically accomplished Director of Cloud & Kubernetes Platform Engineering to lead the design, development, and evolution of our cloud-native platform capabilities. This strategic engineering leadership role is pivotal in building scalable, secure, and resilient cloud and container platforms while driving innovation in platform development across the organization.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in cloud platform engineering across Azure,GCP, and AWS andKubernetes ecosystem development, and multi-cloud architectures, along with a proven track record of building and leading high-performing platform engineering teams. Your engineering leadership will be instrumental in designing foundational platform capabilities, developer experiences, and self-service infrastructure that accelerate the entire engineering organization.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Platform Engineering Strategy**

* Define and execute a forward-looking cloud and Kubernetes platform engineering strategy aligned with enterprise goals and digital transformation initiatives.

* Own P&L responsibility, technology budget management, and ROI optimization for enterprise platform investments acrossAzure,GCP, and AWS.

* Develop and implement platform engineering roadmaps that align business goals with technical execution plans.

* Translate long-term platform vision into prioritized, actionable engineering workstreams.

* Lead the development of strategic platform roadmaps to drive engineering velocity, scalability, and resilience.

**Multi-Cloud Platform Development & Architecture**

* Develop our next-generation cloud-native platforms spanningAzure,GCP,and AWSenabling scalable, portable workloads across a unified multi-cloud estate.

* Design and implement cloud-specific platform capabilities: AWS landing zones using Control Tower and Organizations; Azure platform engineering with Management Groups, Policy, and Blueprints; GCP platform design leveraging Organization Policies, Shared VPC, and Resource Hierarchy.

* Build and govern a consistent cloud abstraction layer that normalizes networking, IAM, secrets management, and compute across all threehyperscalers.

* Lead the engineering of cloud-native managed Kubernetes services Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, and Google GKE into a cohesive, centrally governed multi-cluster platform.

* Design and build internal developer platforms (IDPs) that deliver self-service cloud provisioning, improving developer productivity and time-to-deploy across all cloud environments.

* Lead the engineering of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) frameworks, CI/CD platform toolchains, and automation pipelines to support rapid, repeatable delivery across clouds.

* Drive platform reliability engineering through proactive design, SLO-based engineering, error budgets, and scalable capacity planning.

* Establish and govern cloud platform standards, blueprints, and golden paths for engineering teams to build upon.

**Kubernetes & Container Platform Engineering**

* Lead the design, development, and lifecycle management of enterprise Kubernetes platforms across EKS, AKS, and GKE, including cluster architecture, networking, storage, and multi-tenancy patterns.

* Engineer a unified multi-cluster management plane enabling consistent deployment, policy enforcement, and observability across cloud providers.

* Build and mature container platform capabilities including image management, runtime security, policy enforcement, and workload scheduling.

* Drive adoption of service mesh, advanced networking, and observability tooling within the Kubernetes ecosystem.

* Partner with security teams to embed platform-level security controls, pod security standards, and supply chain security practices.

**Cloud Networking & Connectivity Engineering**

* Partner with the networking team on the design and engineeringcloud networking foundations including AWS Transit Gateway and VPC architecture, Azure Virtual WAN and Hub-Spoke topologies, and GCP Shared VPC and Cloud Interconnect patterns.

* Support the networking team on the build and maintain private connectivity frameworkssuch asAWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, and GCP Dedicated Interconnect, ensuring high-availability hybrid and multi-cloud network paths.

* Partner with the networking team onengineering ofDNS, traffic management, and load balancing platforms across cloud providers to support global application delivery.

**Cloud Identity, Security & Compliance Engineering**

* Engineer cloud identity and access management platforms across AWS IAM and SCPs, Azure Entra ID (Active Directory) and Conditional Access, and GCP IAM with Workload Identity Federation.

* Engineer cloud governance frameworks and embed compliance controls (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2) natively into the platform using AWS Config, Azure Policy, and GCP Organization Policies.

* Champion platform-level security engineering practices across all cloud environments, including secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager), identity federation, and zero-trust networking.

* Leveragecloud security posture management (CSPM) tooling and integrate findings into engineering workflows.

**Team Leadership**

* Inspire, mentor, and manage a global team of cloud platform engineers, Kubernetes specialists, and DevOps practitioners.

* Cultivate a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.

* Recruit, develop, and retain top platform engineering talent.

**Cost & FinOps Engineering**

* In partnership with the Cloud FinOps teamDesign cost-aware platform architectures and implement FinOps practices to optimize cloud expenditure across AWS, Azure, and GCP without compromising performance or security.

* Build tooling and dashboards leveraging AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, and GCP Cloud Billing to give engineering teams visibility into resource utilization and cost attribution.

* Architect tagging strategies, resource hierarchies, and chargeback models to drive engineering accountability for cloud spend.

**Innovation & Platform Evolution**

* Stay ahead of emerging cloud-native technologies, Kubernetes ecosystem developments, andhyperscalerservice releases, proactively integrating capabilities that enhance platform value.

* Drive adoption of emerging patterns includingGitOps,eBPF-based networking, WASM workloads, and AI/ML platform infrastructure across AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, and GCP Vertex AI.

**Qualifications & Critical Skills**

* Bachelor’s orMaster’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

* 15+ years in engineering, including 6+ years in cloud platform or infrastructure engineering leadership roles.

* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale cloud platform engineering programs and Kubernetes-based transformations.

* Deep, hands-on expertise across all three majorhyperscalers: AWS (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, Control Tower), Azure (AKS, Entra ID, Virtual WAN, Azure Policy), and GCP (GKE, Shared VPC, Organization Policy, Vertex AI).

**Position Summary**
The Manager, Network Services is the technical service owner and operational leader for DRiV’s enterprise network, data-center fabric, network security operations, DNS/DHCP, remote connectivity, and voice services. Based in Chicago to provide leadership presence for the primary U.S. data-center environment, the role governs a managed service provider and remains close to the network environment. The Manager is expected to provide hands-on troubleshooting and command during major incidents, outages, and complex changes when needed.
  
  
**Role scope**

* Leading managed service providers supporting network, datacenter, security infrastructure, load balancers, and voice operations
* Stable delivery of global enterprise LAN/WAN and site connectivity
* Managing DNS, DHCP, and NTP services
* Managing wireless access points, controllers, and related infrastructure
* Ownership of firewalls, web proxies, VPN, and related infrastructure with policy governance and approvals owned by Cyber Defense
* Ownership of enterprise voice, SIP, and contact-center services

**Key responsibilities**
**Technical service ownership**

* Validate circuit inventory and invoice accuracy with IT Financial Operations.
* Develop forecasts and business cases for bandwidth, resilience, refresh, modernization, and site connectivity.

* Experience with data-center networks and VXLAN or comparable overlay technologies

Periodic travel may be required. The role participates in planned after-hours changes and critical incident response when necessary.

Title: Lead Major Incident Manager
Description:
**Business Introduction**
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Digital & Tech Command Centre operates 24x7x365 to protect GSK’s critical sites, applications and services. Disruption or degradation to these directly impacts patient supply, research and colleague productivity.
  
  
This role owns and leads the end-to-end response to Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents. In collaboration with AI-enabled monitoring, detection and triage capabilities, the role directs resolver
  
  
teams and subject matter experts from across Tech towards the fastest possible restoration of service, while providing accurate, timely and audience-appropriate communication to end users, senior stakeholders and
  
  
executive leadership. The role also assesses incidents for crisis potential, secures the quality of the incident record for downstream Problem Management, and drives continuous improvement in prevention, detection and response - including the adoption of AI and automation to shorten time to detect, time to engage and time to restore. As a more experienced member of the Major Incident Manager team, the role additionally acts as an escalation point within the team, to support less experienced colleagues, as well as to field senior stakeholders’ questions and requests for information. Additionally, the role supports management of the shift rota, supports the personal
  
  
development of Major Incident Managers through structured feedback and mentoring and leads service-related objectives such as Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  
**Major Incident Response & Command**

* Own the end-to-end management of Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents, from detection through to confirmed service restoration, acting as the single point of control for the duration of the incident.
* Rapidly establish impact, urgency and scope, confirm correct prioritisation, and drive immediate engagement of the right resolver teams, subject matter experts and vendors.
* Lead technical bridges with authority, keeping activity focused on restoration, controlling scope, and ensuring hypotheses are tested and eliminated systematically.
* Drive and record decisions under pressure – balancing speed of restoration against risk.
* Drive resolution against agreed major incident targets, escalating promptly where progress stalls or
* additional authority, resource or vendor commitment is required.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Own incident communications, producing accurate, timely and audience-appropriate updates, including for senior leaders, at agreed intervals.
* Translate complex technical detail into clear business impact language, setting realistic expectations on restoration.
* Act as an escalation point for senior stakeholders’ questions and requests for information, coordinating accurate, consistent responses across resolver teams and owning follow-up through to closure.

**Incident Assessment, Categorisation & Escalation**

* Continuously assess live incidents for impact, applying criteria to determine appropriate handling.
* Trigger escalation routes without delay, providing the initial situational assessment.
* Maintain awareness of site criticality, business-critical periods and service dependencies so that escalation decisions reflect true business risk.

**Service Quality, Data & Continuous Improvement**

* Secure the quality, completeness and accuracy of the incident record – timeline, impact, actions taken and causal indicators – so that Problem Management can be effective.
* Lead or contribute to post-incident reviews, ensuring findings, follow-up actions and preventative measures are captured, owned and tracked to closure.
* Identify recurring themes, fragile services and gaps in monitoring, alerting, knowledge or runbooks, and feed these into improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to the development and adoption of AI, automation and data-driven tooling that shorten time to detect, time to engage and time to restore.
* Drive continual improvements into process and playbooks.
* Lead defined service-related objectives, such as Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives, owning them end to end and tracking measurable improvement.

**Shift Operations & Readiness**

* Operate as part of a 24x7x365 shift pattern, including public holiday and on-call working as required.
* Support management of the shift rota, helping to ensure balanced, compliant 24x7x365 cover across regions, and flagging gaps, fatigue and coverage risks to the Senior Major Incident Manager.
* Deliver rigorous shift handovers so that live incidents, risks and pending actions transfer seamlessly with no loss of context or momentum.
* Maintain personal and team readiness through participation in recovery tests, crisis simulations and major incident rehearsals.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Acts as an escalation point within the team, providing support to less experienced colleagues.
* Support the personal development of Major Incident Managers, including through structured feedback sessions and mentoring, helping to raise the capability, consistency and resilience of the MIM
* community.
* Approach and Collaboration
* Bring a team-first collaborative mindset and approach, to ensure effective cross-functional working.

Why You?
  
  
**Basic Qualification**
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, IT or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years in IT service operations within a large, complex, global organisation, including time in a Major Incident Management role.
* ITIL v4 certification is required.
* Experience with leading P1 incidents end to end, directing multiple technical teams and third parties concurrently.
* Experience communicating during live incidents to a range of audiences, including senior leaders, under time pressure.

Title: Associate Vice President – IT Service Delivery
Director Field Service Operations – Southeast Region
Staff Technical Project Manager, Global Physical Security
Description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

We're hiring a Staff Technical Project Manager to own delivery of Crusoe's Global Physical Security (GPS) portfolio. Your deliverable is the outcome, not the schedule: every site moved onto our new platforms, a working GSOC, and site findings closed.

You'll run several related workstreams at once across Construction, Facilities, IT, site operations, integrators and vendors. None of them report to you. You'll turn loose commitments into dated, owned, checkable deliverables, hold people to them, and force decisions when work stalls.

This is a program role, not a project role. You'll be the person who sees a slip coming weeks out and raises it with options, rather than reporting the miss after it lands.  
  
**Level:** Staff.
  
**Reports to:** Lead, IT & Security Program Management Office.
  
**Location:** San Francisco, CA; Denver, CO; or Dallas, TX.

**What You'll Be Working on:**

* **System Lifecycle & Deployment:** Manage end-to-end delivery of physical security assets—including access control, video surveillance (CCTV), intrusion detection, and Security Operations Centers (SOC)—from design and installation to testing and commissioning.
* **Standards & Governance:** Own and adapt global physical security standards, master specifications (e.g., Division 28), and reference design templates across regions.
* **Cross-Functional Integration:** Partner with IT, network engineering, legal, privacy, and facilities teams to integrate physical security systems with enterprise networks and digital tracking tools (CAD/BIM validation, dashboards).
* **Vendor & Contractor Management:** Direct external security system integrators, author technical scopes of work, evaluate RFPs, manage bids, and oversee site quality assurance (QA/QC).
* **Risk & Change Management:** Conduct site risk assessments, handle design-exception governance, and manage brownfield/retrofit upgrades with zero or minimal operational downtime.

You'll own six workstreams that together make up the GPS program.

* **Access control and video platform migration.** Move every site off the legacy Meraki estate onto our selected cloud-based access control and video platforms, and onboard new sites as they come online. Waves run Q2 through Q4.

* Wave planning and site sequencing
* Per-site readiness criteria and tracking
* Cutover runbooks and rollback plans
* Acceptance testing and sign-off

* **GSOC buildout.** Bring our Global Security Operations Center to go-live. Coordinate facility readiness, technology cutover, staff onboarding and the go-live checklist across Construction, IT and our staffing vendor.
* **Site remediation.** Our security assessments produce a findings register, and most fixes belong to Facilities, Construction or site ops. You'll get each finding an owner and a date, drive it to close, and keep the register visible to leadership.
* **Integrator delivery.** Manage multiple integrators across geographies.

* Scope-of-work templates
* Submittal review cycles
* Acceptance testing and defect closeout
* Integrator performance scorecards

* **Vendor and procurement lifecycle.** Run RFPs, contract timelines and onboarding for staffing, platform and monitoring vendors. Several of these land this quarter and next.
* **Intake and triage.** Stand up a front door for new GPS requests so each one is scoped, prioritized and sequenced against the roadmap instead of quietly absorbed.

**How You'll Work:**

* **Make commitments real.** Turn "we'll get to it" into a named owner, a date and a clear definition of done.
* **Hold the line on dates.** Hold peers, vendors and people senior to you to what they committed, directly and respectfully.
* **Lead without authority.** Drive work across orgs you don't control, and escalate only when escalation is the right tool.
* **Call slippage early.** Read leading indicators such as late submittals, long-lead equipment and unstaffed shifts. Raise risk while there's still time to act.
* **Force decisions.** Know the difference between work that needs chasing and work that needs someone to decide. Get the decision framed, put it in front of the right person, and get it made.
* **Set the standard.** Define how GPS runs programs, including planning templates, readiness criteria, status cadence and scorecards that other teams adopt.
* **Exercise discretion.** You'll handle site layouts, vulnerabilities and incident details. You know what to share, with whom and when.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 10+ years in technical program or project management, including at least 5 years owning a multi-workstream program end to end
* Delivery experience in the built environment, including construction schedules, integrators, submittals, commissioning and turnover
* A track record of multi-site rollouts across a geographically distributed portfolio
* Enough technical fluency in access control, video surveillance, networking and low-voltage systems to challenge an integrator's plan and spot when you're being talked in circles
* Experience running vendor work end to end: RFPs, SOWs, contract milestones, acceptance and performance management
* Comfort holding senior stakeholders and vendors accountable, and forcing decisions without leaning on escalation
* Clear, concise written status reporting that leads with risk and the ask
* Sound judgment and discretion with sensitive security information

* Experience standing up a GSOC, SOC or other 24/7 operations center
* Background in data center, critical facilities or mission-critical construction
* Experience managing contract security staffing or remote monitoring vendors
* PMP, PgMP, PSP or CPP certification
* Familiarity with security frameworks and audits that touch physical controls, such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001

**Bonus Points**

* Hands-on experience with cloud-managed access control and VMS platforms, or with migrating from one to another

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off
* Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $230,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.
